schema_info.standard: Service Design Role Card Standard v1.1

identity.title: Senior Sales Representative
identity.description: High-performing individual contributor in enterprise sales, responsible for quota attainment, customer relationships, and pipeline development. Navigates complex internal systems while maximising customer-facing time.

professionalContext.career_stage: Mid-career professional with advancement aspirations to sales management
responsibilities: Exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas
Develop and maintain key enterprise accounts
Collaborate with internal teams on proposals and deals
workflows: Daily customer data management and opportunity tracking
Weekly forecast reviews and pipeline updates

roleBasedNeeds.text: Develop leadership skills for future management role
Build stronger relationships with key enterprise accounts
Improve efficiency in proposal and contract processes
Access customer information quickly while on the road

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Too much time spent on administrative tasks instead of selling
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Reduces time available for customer-facing activities

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Difficulty accessing customer information while on the road
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Impacts meeting preparation and customer interactions

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Slow approval processes for custom pricing
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Delays deal closure and frustrates customers

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Inconsistent training on new products and features
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Affects confidence when presenting to customers

custom.travel_requirements: Frequent travel to customer sites (40-50% of time)
custom.performance_review_frequency: Quarterly with formal reviews every 6 months
